title: The best free AI recruiting tools for sourcing and hiring
summary: Explore the best free AI recruiting tools, compare free tiers and pricing, and find top options for sourcing, screening, scheduling, and hiring faster.
body_markdown:
As your team grows, so does your tech stack—and with it, your monthly spend on[recruiting software](https://juicebox.ai/blog/recruiting-software-for-startups) .


When you’re looking for a new tool to streamline some functions, you might be tempted to invest in a robust solution with extra features that could be useful in the future. But there are dozens of free tools on the market, whether permanently free or on a trial basis, that could be exactly the fix you need.


Here’s a list of the best free AI[recruiting tools](https://juicebox.ai/blog/ai-recruiting-tools) that can limit your busywork and improve productivity without breaking the budget.


## **What “free” means for AI recruiting tools**


There are three ways that an AI recruiting tool can be free:


- **Permanent free tiers:** Some tools offer a free plan, no strings attached. You gain access to the tool indefinitely.
- **Freemium plans:** Freemium plans are similar to free ones but with some limits. You gain access to select features, usually with some limits (fewer available seats, less access to all tools, usage restrictions), for basic functionality. There’s usually the option to upgrade to a better plan.
- **Time-limited trials:** Free trials let you access all of the tools' features for a set period, helping you decide if you’d like to make a purchase. After the trial is up, you usually lose access.


## **The best free AI tools for recruitment, by use case**


We’ve put together a list that groups tools by function, with each entry noting the type of “free” that it is, and the main limitations of each tool.


### **Best for AI sourcing**


Sourcing candidates takes up hours of a recruiter’s time. The best AI[sourcing tools](https://juicebox.ai/blog/best-sourcing-tools-for-recruiters) you can access for free include:


- **Juicebox:** With a free search to start,[Juicebox](https://juicebox.ai/) is the best sourcing pick on the market. It offers natural-language search across over 800 million profiles, with directable AI agents and contact data accessible. Juicebox’s AI talent sourcing searches across more than 30 data sources and has the power to reach passive candidates that other tools might miss.
- **hireEZ Boolean Builder:** hireEZ offers a[free Boolean search builder](https://toolkit.hireez.com/solutions/boolean-builder/?_gl=1*o7onur*_gcl_au*MTc3Mzk2OTE4OC4xNzg3NTg0OTAw*_ga*NTU5MDA5MTkuMTc4NzU4NDg5OQ..*_ga_40KG1DLQ1P*czE3ODc2NjU3NzIkbzMkZzEkdDE3ODc2NjU3OTEkajQxJGwwJGgw*_ga_9T1S4N5FXQ*czE3ODc2NjU3NzMkbzMkZzEkdDE3ODc2NjU3OTMkajQwJGwwJGgxNTkyMjQ0NzE5) that helps you put together the right string of words to optimize sourcing searches. This feature is always free.


### **Best for screening and assessment**


Once you have candidates in the pipeline, it’s time for resume parsing. These[hiring tools](https://juicebox.ai/blog/best-ai-hiring-tools) can help:


- **Manatal:**[Manatal](https://www.manatal.com/) is a full-service applicant tracking system (ATS) with AI-powered tools like candidate filtering that work 24/7. The AI can also evaluate applicants on consistent criteria to limit bias in the hiring process. Mantal offers a 14-day free trial, but some features aren’t available until you upgrade to a paid plan.
- **Breezy HR:** Post active roles on over 50 job boards with[Breezy HR](https://breezy.hr/) , which offers an unlimited free trial. The trial does have limits, including only one active job listing and only seeing candidates added in the past 30 days, but for simple hiring needs, the free plan and screening tools make up for it.


### **Best for outreach and engagement**


Tools that automate outreach and engagement save hiring teams a lot of time otherwise spent personalizing messages and filtering through applicants:


- **Recruit CRM:**[Recruit CRM](https://recruitcrm.io/) is a lightweight ATS and CRM combination tool, with a free plan that has no time limit, although it does have some usage limits. You do get access to the basics, though, making it a viable short-term fix for small teams with simple recruiting needs or looking to test several tools before committing.
- **Gem:** Although[Gem](https://www.gem.com/) is also a screening and scheduling tool, it has certain sequencing features you can use for outreach, including personalized messaging across candidates and strong applicant tracking features. You can access a six-month free trial (if you have under 30 employees) before you have to upgrade to a paid plan.
- **LinkedIn Recruiter Lite:** With a free-month trial, you can test LinkedIn’s built-in recruiter tools for candidate sourcing and bulk messaging. It integrates directly with many ATS for smoother hiring processes.


### **Best for scheduling**


Finding time to meet with candidates is another time-consuming but crucial task, aided by these tools:


- **Calendly:** For easy scheduling,[Calendly’s](https://calendly.com/) free plan integrates with many popular tools and lets users customize availability. The free version is limited in that it only supports 1:1 meetings and one meeting scheduling page, but for small teams, that’s all they need.
- **Zoho Recruit:**[Zoho Recruit](https://www.zoho.com/recruit/) is entirely free if you’re only hiring for one job, which is functional for small teams who want one tool that spans the entire hiring process, from sourcing to onboarding. It covers candidate management and interview scheduling, alongside major automations for hiring workflows.


## **What the best free AI recruiting tools can’t do**


Free plans usually give access to basic features, but they might restrict high-impact workflows or advanced automations.


### **Core workflows free plans restrict**


The main ways that free plans restrict users are usually usage or seat limits:


- **Seat limits:** How many team members need to access a tool might impact which plan you can access. Many free plans only allow one user, so if your hiring team is more than a single recruiter, you’ll need to upgrade your plan.
- **Usage limits:** On a free plan, you might only be able to run one search or job post at a time. Other usage caps might include a set number of searches or candidates you can review per month, limiting your hiring. This is fine for slow hiring periods, but not ideal if you have a high-volume position or multiple open roles.
- **Restricted features:** Plans might simply not allow you to access every feature without upgrading to a paid plan. In some cases, that means you either need a secondary tool or to upgrade to use the tool functionally. However, the best AI recruiting tools for startups have low limits that might cover your hiring needs.


### **Advanced automation and evaluation**


For some tools, you need a paid plan to access the features that make it worthwhile to use. Advanced automation, ATS integration, resume parsing, and multi-channel outreach are all features that recruiters will need but might be restricted behind usage limits or the next subscription tier.


## **How to choose the right free tool**


The best tools for you are the ones that solve your pain points. Take the time to identify your biggest bottleneck and go from there. Are you spending too much time sourcing new candidates? Is scheduling interviews a major headache for hiring managers and talent acquisition teams? Do you just need some CRM maintenance that limits busywork?


From there, you can shop for a solution that aligns with your team size and hiring volume.


### **Match the tool to your workflow**


Look for tools designed to address your problems, not all-in-one solutions. You don’t need a heavyweight CRM if your main problem is sourcing candidates.


### **Check fit before features**


Prioritize tools that fit with your existing tech stack over ones with flashy features. If you think you’ve found the perfect screening solution but it won’t integrate with your ATS, it’s not the right one for your talent acquisition team.


Once you know the tool works with your existing programs, you can check for other key features: setup speed, AI scoring, candidate completion, and an upgrade path. You want something that’s fast to implement and has the potential to scale with your team.

### **Is there a free AI recruiting tool for startups?**

### **What is the difference between a free tier and a free trial?**
